lines.text: At the windy lookout, Kate pulled off a glove to take a photo and set it on the rock.
One gust, and it was gone over the edge.
She hiked down with one bare hand stuffed in her pocket.
Take gloves off only out of the wind,
and tuck them inside your jacket, never on the ground.
Wear thin liners for your phone, and pack a spare pair.
Save this before your next cold hike.
